claims: HIPAA Privacy Rule protects individually identifiable health information.
Privacy Act of 1974 governs personal data usage by federal agencies.
GLBA (Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act) regulates financial institutions' handling of consumer data.
Over 20 states have enacted comprehensive data privacy laws.
California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) grants consumers rights over their personal information and how it is shared or sold.
California has comprehensive state-level data privacy laws.
Virginia has comprehensive state-level data privacy laws.
Federal Trade Commission (FTC) handles violations relating to unfair or deceptive acts such as failing to maintain promised security.
U.S. lacks a single comprehensive federal privacy law.
U.S. relies on sector-specific rules for data privacy.
EU has GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation).
